//: Plain JSON: Orca reads this with JSON.parse, so notes live in this key, which it keeps when Settings > Shortcuts rewrites the file.
macOS only, and only on Cmd (Mod), like wezterm.lua's Cmd layer: Ctrl and Alt stay with nvim, tmux and zsh in the terminal tabs. On Linux and Windows Mod is Ctrl.
Cmd-N and Cmd-Left/Right are WezTerm's new tab and tab switching; Create worktree keeps Cmd-Shift-N.
Cmd-, is unbound by default so that Codex in a terminal gets it.
Dictation is off: Cmd-E would ask for the microphone.
